title: Readiness Trace matrix renderer (FBS-208, TAC-4136, ADR-4140)
description: Pure HTML-string renderer: buildTraceMatrixRows + renderTraceMatrix emit the matrix for a REQ/US/AC pivot (rows: US + AC under the pivot; cols: TS / TC / FBS / CN; cells: reached + resolution from coverage). Empty states for no-pivot, unknown-pivot and downstream-pivot (TS/TC/FBS/CN/TAC/ADR) all offer the lookup. >200 rows renders a client-side filter bar.
